red_flags: Only ~5-6 Google reviews total; only 3 contain any written text, the rest are star-only
No independent verified-review platform (no klantenvertellen, Trustpilot or Trustoo presence found)
One of the positive 5-star reviews is from 'Lisa Brok' (same surname as the owner Erik Brok) - likely a relative, not an independent customer
Single-platform corpus (Google only); reviews span 6 years so volume is very low
CBR pass rate is below the exam-location average (39% first-attempt / 46% school vs 54% location average), which the lone negative review echoes ('haakt af net voor examen')
review_summary: The very small, single-platform (Google) review corpus describes Erik Brok as a patient instructor who gives personal attention and good support, but the evidence base is thin - only about three reviews carry any text, one positive review is from a likely relative (Lisa Brok), and the single recent negative review complains the instructor quit on the student right before the exam. No verified or independent-platform reviews and no sign of English-language/expat lessons.
